# Emphasis Style

This page begins with *asterisk emphasis* so the document establishes that marker as its expected style. Later in the same paragraph, *the second phrase* uses a conflicting delimiter and is the sole intended repair. A code literal `*not emphasis*` and an escaped marker \_plain punctuation\_ must remain unchanged, as must the Unicode phrase 東京の案内.

The final paragraph explains that emphasis markers encode the same inline meaning even when their spelling changes. The independent answer therefore updates just the second emphasis span, leaving all visible words, code contents, escaped punctuation, and paragraph boundaries intact.
